content: MK reports that in Nafsat I Ṣāʾin al-Dīn dwells in particular on Khwāja Muḥammad Pārsā, the Naqshbandi leader and Shāhrukh's favourite, and separates such Sufis from charlatans who use charisma and cunning to gather disciples and control rulers, or excuse laziness and libertinism by chanting “Everything is God!” and so fall into heresy; MK says this barb is clearly directed at the followers of Fażl Allāh, among others.
